source_code_evidence.meaning: Ultralytics raw9 keypoints are exported unchanged in channel order, only the known reflected image border is subtracted
Combiner applies pointwise correction/cap to copies of qN/q0; no correspondence search
Each corrected native[k] remains channel k; cap writes the same indices and preserves centroid8
q0/qN/current native qFinal and native-numbering preservation recorded in original frozen experiment

use_contract: For new raw camera-dynamic9 outputs from the same R0 channel convention, join corner channel k to existing current native_slot k. This is input identity, not a new match to human reference corner IDs. Existing human-native ledger correspondence stays frozen; do not reapply its old scoring branch/permutation.
